notes:
Primary table tests between-game Pool B contributions; supplied locator describes within-group pool allocation. Replication values are author-derived primary master-table values, retained as printed. Corrupted Greek metric labels preserved; no conversion performed. Table sample N is not independently established as analytic N. Original: DOI landing returned 403; OpenAlex/Unpaywall supplied no open-access full-text location; additional available author/repository routes did not yield the full original. Replication-source original statistics were not substituted. 
Source follow-up: Only the assigned original side was examined. Title and authors match the supplied reference; source is the published article. The locator and outcome identify the pool-W communication comparison, reported as an increase from 47% without communication to 68% after communication. The requested printed test statistic is retained without conversion. The frozen text renders equals signs as 5; quotations preserve that rendering, while test_statistic normalizes the equality sign. Analytic n is left null because the target t(29) is not clearly reconciled with the general statement of twenty 3-person groups per condition; the total of 240 male participants is not substituted. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
